require "securerandom"

class RequestId
  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
    headers["x-request-id"] = SecureRandom.uuid
    [status, headers, body]
  end
end

Wrote `request_id.rb`: a `RequestId` middleware that sets a fresh UUID as the `x-request-id` header on every response. I haven't run it.

The header name is lowercase because Rack 3 requires lowercase response header keys; HTTP headers are case-insensitive, so clients still see it as `X-Request-Id`.

It always generates a new ID and does not reuse an incoming `X-Request-Id` from the request.

Use it with `use RequestId` in your `config.ru`.
